title: Hallowed Be Thy Name
lyrics: And You will never [Am]change O Lord[D]
Jehovah-[C]Rophe[Am], perfect health You give to me
Jehovah-[C]Shalom, You're the One who gives me peace
Jehovah-[C]Rohi[Am], my Faithful Shepherd leading me
